name: operational-issues
description: The operational issues report (2026-11-17). A notification whose filter names a question the survey does not have is listed as a filter that does not work, found by checking it, and after a submission as a notification error, recorded against the notification (log.ref) so its Fix button opens that notification in its project. Unreviewed conflicts from the conflict tests are listed with a Fix button that opens the record in the console. The page shows the issues, its filters work, and the XLSX download is a spreadsheet. Uses the case-alerts survey, which it keeps the notification on; the notification sends to the ca_name question, whose answers are not addresses, so nothing is sent. Each run adds one record to that survey.
